en: The Question on the Characteristic of Attention (Manasikāra)
"Venerable Nāgasena, what is the characteristic of attention, and what is the characteristic of wisdom?
"Great King, attention has the characteristic of investigation, and wisdom has the characteristic of cutting," he replied.

“How is attention characterized by investigation? How is wisdom characterized by cutting? Please provide an analogy. “Do you know, Great King, how one deals with a field of barley? [The King replied: “I know it, Venerable Sir. [The Elder said: “When a field of barley is full of weeds, what does the farmer do? [The King replied: “He has the weeds pulled up by the roots and throws them away. [The Elder asked: “And what does he do with those weeds? [The King replied: “He cuts them at the base with a sickle, chops them with a hatchet, and burns them in a fire. [The Elder asked: “And what does he do with the ashes? [The King replied: “He winnows them in a strong wind or throws them into flowing water. [The Elder said: “In this way, Great King, attention is like the sickle; wisdom is like the hatchet; the burning of the ashes is like the path of concentration; and the winnowing in a strong wind or throwing into flowing water is like the path of the fruit of arahantship. [The King said: “Venerable Sir, if that is so, then attention is indeed characterized by investigation, and wisdom is indeed characterized by cutting. [The Elder said: “It is so, Great King. “And how, great king, do barley-reapers reap the barley?
“By grasping a sheaf of barley with the left hand, venerable sir, and taking a sickle with the right hand, they cut it with the sickle.”
“Just as, Great King, a barley-reaper, taking a bundle of barley with his left hand and a sickle with his right hand, cuts the barley;

even so, Great King, does the practitioner of yoga, having taken hold of the mind with attention, cut off the defilements with wisdom. Thus, Great King, attention has the characteristic of grasping, and wisdom has the characteristic of cutting.
The eighth question: on the characteristic of mental attention.
